name: engineer-agent-context
job: Engineer a Context and Memory Contract that bounds what agents load, with budgets, freshness, and invalidation.

inScope: Inventorying information classes, owners, and authority order
Defining write, retrieve, rank, summarize, invalidate, and delete rules
Setting token, latency, storage, and retrieval budgets
Testing stale, poisoned, conflicting, and leaking context

inputs: Information classes and their sources and owners
Current assembly order and authority rules
outputs: Context and Memory Contract with budgets and authority order

data: source-of-truth locators outside the context window
permissions: least-disclosure access per tenant and credential rules

failureSemantics: Context is a bounded projection with lineage, never the authority; agent-generated summaries are never the only durable copy; vector similarity is never treated as relevance, correctness, or permission; decision utility is measured, not retrieval volume.

outcome.observable: A Context and Memory Contract where every information class has an owner and authority order, budgets are explicit, invalidation and deletion rules work, and adversarial and degradation tests pass.
